ChangedVariableOut.description:
A variable whose current value differs from the snapshot (AC-17); a Restricted value is
never shown: `masked` with both values null.
ChangedVariableOut.title: ChangedVariableOut

CiteRun.description: A citation marker: a verified citation id (INV-2), never text.
CiteRun.title: CiteRun

ClauseBlock-Input.description: A clause from the template's library; `non_standard` when it differs from the standard.
ClauseBlock-Input.title: ClauseBlock

ClauseBlock-Output.description: A clause from the template's library; `non_standard` when it differs from the standard.
ClauseBlock-Output.title: ClauseBlock

CompareOut.description: A deterministic word-level diff by block and clause id (AC-23).
CompareOut.title: CompareOut

FieldRegionOut.description: Where a variable or field sits on the rendered page (AC-22): PDF points, top-left origin.
FieldRegionOut.title: FieldRegionOut

GeneratedDocumentOut.description: One generated document: its computed status (DF-31) and its insert-only versions.
GeneratedDocumentOut.title: GeneratedDocumentOut

ImageBlock.description: A firm asset stored as evidence (letterhead, signature image): never a URL (AC-9).
ImageBlock.title: ImageBlock

LegendBlock.description: Repeats on every page (an AR-C 70 package's legend, AC-11).
LegendBlock.title: LegendBlock

OwnerRefOut.description: The consumer record the document belongs to (an engagement letter, a notice response).
OwnerRefOut.title: OwnerRefOut

RenderTicketOut.description: A render accepted: the new version is Drafting until its job finishes.
RenderTicketOut.title: RenderTicketOut

RequesterOut.description: Who asked for the version: "<person> via Agent" for an agent's draft (INV-5).
RequesterOut.title: RequesterOut

SectionBlock-Input.description: A section; `override` marks paragraphs a person wrote in the consumer's editor.
SectionBlock-Input.title: SectionBlock

SectionBlock-Output.description: A section; `override` marks paragraphs a person wrote in the consumer's editor.
SectionBlock-Output.title: SectionBlock

TableBlock.description: Cells are decimal strings from the snapshot; the renderer never sums (ADR-050).
TableBlock.title: TableBlock

TemplatePreviewOut.description: A SAMPLE-watermarked render from the version's synthetic sample data; never evidence.
TemplatePreviewOut.title: TemplatePreviewOut

TextRun.description: Literal text: rendered escaped, never interpreted (AC-8).
TextRun.title: TextRun

VarRun.description: A declared variable, resolved server-side by the kind's provider (AC-10).
VarRun.title: VarRun

abacus__modules__reporting__contract__Te.description:
A template bundle (AC-1): structured blocks, declared variables and synthetic sample data
only (AC-2: no markup, no URL).
abacus__modules__reporting__contract__Te.title: TemplateImportIn
